'''Bug One''' was a [[YVH-Series battle droid|YVH-Series]] [[YVH 5-S Bugcruncher|bugcruncher]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that fought for the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]]. Along with [[Bug Two|three]] [[Bug Three|other]] [[Bug Four|bugcrunchers]], Bug One accompanied [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Kr]] on a [[Battle of Kr|mission to rescue]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], from the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of the [[Gorog]] nest. In the zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] conditions of the [[ethmane]] corridors on Kr, Bug One fought swarms of the Gorog Killiks until he was disabled by a barrage of [[Electrobolt assault rifle|electrobolt]] fire as the team made its way to aid the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Major eneeemyyy conceeeee&hellip; Deeeeee&hellip;eee&hellip;e&hellip;|Bug One, disabled by the Gorog Killiks|<ref name="King" />}}
Bug One was produced by [[Tendrando Arms]] and was active during the period of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], a series of conflicts in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] involving the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[the Colony]], the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], the [[New Jedi Order]], and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="King" /> In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Tendrando Arms loaned [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], Bug One and three other [[YVH-Series battle droid|YVH-Series]] [[YVH 5-S Bugcruncher|5-S Bugcruncher]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], named [[Bug Two]] through [[Bug Four|Four]], all of whom were specifically [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] to Solo's specifications. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] quartet accompanied Solo; [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi trainee]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]; and a team of four [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] in the ''Millennium Falcon'' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qoribu]]'s [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Kr]], the [[Kr nest|nesting]] site of the [[Gorog]] Killiks, who were manipulating the Colony into engaging the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] in increasing acts of warfare.<ref name="King" />

While the Chiss and the Killiks of the Colony [[Battle of Qoribu|clashed]] above Qoribu, the ''Millennium Falcon'' took Bug One and the other members of the team down a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] shaft in Kr's [[ethmane]] jungles to the nest site, aiming to rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his wife, [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], who were [[Battle of Kr|fighting]] Gorog Killiks there. Bug One and the other YVH droids disembarked from the [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter]] ahead of the other passengers into Kr's zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] conditions before the entire team ventured into the nest's maze of ethmane tunnels, with the non-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] members using [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] and the Jedi using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to propel themselves. Before long, Bug One engaged the first of the Gorog whom they found in the fragile ethmane tunnels. Despite their losses, the Gorog came at the rescue team in a relentless swarm, and Bug One, along with Bug Two and [[Bug Three]], soon exhausted their supply of [[Laminanium/Legends|laminanium]] repair ingots replenishing their [[Armor/Legends|armor]] damaged in the fighting.<ref name="King" />

Seeing that using only [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and the Jedi's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] would not get them through the swarm to find Skywalker and Jade, Solo authorized ''"By Any Means"'' status, permitting Bug One and the other YVH droids to use their [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]] to fight the enemy, despite the fragility of the tunnels. The use of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] in the droids' [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] launchers allowed the team to press forward at a much quicker pace, destroying the opposing Killiks in bunches. However, at the head of the team, Bug One met a fierce counterattack from the Gorog at a corner in the tunnels, and a barrage from the Killiks' [[electrobolt assault rifle]]s sent a disabled Bug One spinning into a wall and an armed detonator from his grenade launcher floating near the team. The Jedi used the Force to send the detonator at the Killiks before it could go off, and the rescue team went on to relieve the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]], who were fighting farther ahead in the tunnels.<ref name="King" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Authorization code ''do it now'' accepted. ''"By Any Means"'' status&mdash;''" [thermal detonator explodes]|Bug One, authorized to use thermal detonators|<ref name="King" />|trans=1}}
As a [[Class four droid/Legends|fourth-degree]]<ref name="Note">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' identifies Bug One as a [[YVH-Series battle droid]], which ''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'' classifies as a [[Class four droid/Legends|class four droid]].</ref> YVH 5-S Bugcruncher battle droid,<ref name="King" /> Bug One possessed the droid series' customary masculine programming and the voice of Tendrando Arms creator [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="Star" /> He was also equipped with the series' [[Realspace/Legends|space]] chassis<ref name="Swarm">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> and had thrusters that permitted him to travel in zero-gravity conditions. Armored in laminanium, Bug One could use ingots of the metal to repair himself mid-battle, and he was further equipped with a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], a grenade launcher that fired thermal detonators, a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and [[Color/Legends|green]] lubricant in his internal systems. The battle droid required authorization to activate ''"By Any Means,"'' or BAM, status, which allowed him to use any means at his disposal to complete the current task.<ref name="King" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bug One first appeared in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', the first volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="King" />
